deadline_qualification: Monotonic budget checked before request, after headers, every raw chunk, and before/after JSON; each blocking HTTPX operation also uses a finite inactivity timeout. Tests prove finite trickle processing stops and closes without retry. They do not prove hard wall-clock preemption of an already blocked socket operation; an in-flight operation can finish after the logical budget before the next check.
limits: No real network/RPC/orders/funding, signing, daemon/services, installs, model/inference/indexing or owner/config/archive writes.
No empirical strategy/performance qualification; regression must-pass suite only.

Global record-factory wrapper is context-local in effect and preserves the prior factory. Applications that themselves capture raw values inside a custom earlier factory are outside these handler-level tests.
Independent acceptance and repository delivery remain root-owned.
self_review: Final source/hunk scan is author self-review. Parent must re-trigger original fresh reviewer.
remaining: Fresh reviewer independently accepts/rejects these exact hashes; parent records ledger/delivery.
